description: Query rows of a published layer (`layer_id`) or table (`table_id`). Optional `bbox` (minx,miny,maxx,maxy in WGS84 degrees), `filters` (list of {field, op, value}; op is eq/ne/lt/lte/gt/gte for numeric fields, eq/ne/contains for text), `fields` (attribute names to return), `limit` (max 1000) and `cursor` from a previous page. Set `geometry` true to include GeoJSON geometry. Returns feature ids with attributes.

table_id.description: For table datasets (CSV / XLSX); use instead of layer_id.

name: query_features
title: Query a dataset's features
